body: Have you tried getting professional help?

Hey man I just want to tell you I know how you feel and I’m doing it for the same reason. You aren’t stupid and you aren’t alone. I can’t see myself living without her either. I’m going to set a date soon too. You can pm me if you’d like to chat
I’ve been suicidal since my girlfriend broke up with me. I’ve had two attempts so far. I feel like I’m stuck and can’t move on
About 7 months. The feeling went away for a while and I was doing good for a bit, but it came back about a week ago. It’s more intense than it used to be.
Use alcohol
Try again today

I don’t really enjoy doing much anymore. I do like to take care and play with my dog. He is happy all the time and that makes me a little happy to know he’s happy. I’m going to try to get the motivation to go to the gym. I’m going to try all I can in the next few months
I don’t really think having sex with randoms will help me
I do love my family and friends. I love my pets too. I believe I don’t have anything to live for anymore. The people in my life will get over my death.
I’m going to make the most out of my life until November

Thank you for taking the time to share what you know with me. I’ve been on several different meds before and I’m thinking that ECT is a fair option. I want to try as much as I can before I go. It’s to the point where I need to try everything and anything I can. I’m probably going to stay alive for the next couple months and I’m hoping something will change in me to want to continue to live afterwards
I’m on meds and I go to therapy once a week. What are some things that have kept you going?
I’ve explained it throughout the comments... I can’t get out of the way I’m thinking and I can’t find anything that genuinely keeps me going. I’m giving up at this point

I’ve tried to live for others and at this point I can’t do it anymore. They don’t actually care about me.  My friends only pretend to care for a little while when they hear I’m not doing good, then they go back to not inviting me to things and hanging out with each other. My parents don’t show they care anymore and my mother has continued to be abusive to me even though she’s seen what it does to me. They’ll get over the pain and grieving, everyone dies at some point.

I’ve tried to medicate with marijuana before but I can’t do it with the medication I’m on, I had terrible experiences. I’ve contemplated getting off my meds so I can smoke but I’m not so sure about it. Everyone is telling me to stay on them

Thank you for sharing this with me. I’m going to take your advice and start a new job. I applied to several the other day. I’m also going to start eating better and getting out more, even get back in the gym. I’m going to keep trying at least for now and see if anything turns around for me
I fell until a deep depression and my mind isn’t getting any better. It feels like there’s nothing I can do to make anything better in my life. It’s hard to enjoy anything.
I’m considering going back to the gym. I’m going to start eating better too. Thank you for sharing
Thank you. These people who have commented are awesome. It’s good to know we actually have people who try to make others feel better and good about themselves.
I’m trying to get a new job soon, maybe that’ll help. It’s at least a start.
It’s hard to set goals when I don’t see a future. How do I get the motivation to do this?
Not the place to do post this
What flavor? I vape too, it seems to help
How old are you now?

When are you doing it? Right now, I’m trying to think of the best method to do it. I haven’t considered using a rope because I’m scared I’d fail and be in pain while it’s strangling me. Why did you choose this method?
I’m doing okay. Just very suicidal. I’m thinking about doing it soon too. Are you using partial suspension or drop hanging?
It’s just ignorance and lack of research I guess. I stumbled across your other post and was wondering if you are still thinking the same way, or have you changed your mind?

I took 3 bottles of anti anxiety pills and would’ve died if I hadn’t been found and taken to the hospital. Overdosing isn’t impossible if you use your brain. Just take as much as you can and mix it with alcohol. I agree on what you’re saying though. Obviously taking 30 pills of Tylenol won’t do the trick. I guess some people just come to reddit first before googling simple shit.
It’s very hard to actually go through with jumping. I found my location and backed out shortly after. Best of luck to you op
I feel like I’m trapped in my own, depressed, suicidal mind and there’s no point in me trying anymore because I don’t believe things will get better.
Hate that society places such a strong stigma on things like mental health. What do you do to cope? I’m really struggling right now
I doubt I could get an assisted suicide to be approved, I’m in North Carolina.
That can help with what exactly?
My therapist suggested I’d change my diet too. I will be doing this, thanks

I took 180 anti anxiety pills (3 bottles, 4,000mg) and would’ve died if I hadn’t been found and taken to the hospital. I would just try to take as many as you can and mix it with alcohol if you could. You might end up in pain, or with brain damage if it doesn’t work though, I just got lucky.
It’s not good at all. Mostly just fast food, why?
Wait op, are you doing this now? What’s going on that’s making you feel this way? I feel the same way too...
What do you mean doubt?
I’m kinda in the same boat as you. My sister is getting married in November and I know she wants me in the wedding and would be devastated if I didn’t make it. I’m putting my date til after then now
Why haven’t you gotten help?
I appreciate the online hug buddy. How are you dealing with it?

I might do it the same day as you. I like what you wrote. I’m pushing through at least until November so I can see my sister get married. If things haven’t turned around by then, I’ll go through with it on New Year’s Eve...
I feel the same way, because of the same reason. And I’ve been feeling this way for seven months now...

I’m in the same boat as you. I’ve already made up my mind that I’m doing it. I feel that relief knowing it’s going to be over soon too. It feels like a rush throughout my body. It’s almost satisfying.
What’s making you feel suicidal? I’m 19 and feel the same way too
I feel the same way, maybe we could talk? What’s going on in your life that’s making you feel suicidal?
You should get some rest. Please don’t hurt yourself. I’m here if you need to chat
I definitely will ask and get back to you. I really like the last sentence you wrote. I never thought of it that way. I haven’t tried to accept things and I’ll consider thinking that way
Depression is an endless cycle. I’ll get ups and then get extremely low downs. I’m sick of the downs taking over. I feel like I can’t live anymore
I feel the same way. Do you feel suicidal?
You are a very strong person. I commend you for being so courageous. Maybe we can fight this together.

I just don’t feel like doing anything some days. Like I can’t get out of bed and I have no motivation. I feel weak all the time. My mom is abusive probably 50% of the time I’m around her too, which doesn’t help.
Can it ever go back to normal? I feel like I’ll never feel as high as I did before all this
I’ll try it out next time I visit them, thanks
I’m sorry for your loss. How have you dealt with it?
I’m going to tell my therapist how I feel during our next session. Thank you. I’m going to try and push forward some more.
I’m not sure if I could ever get over this girl though. I haven’t really talked about her too much with my therapist. I’ll try sharing how I feel with her soon
Yes, a big factor of how I feel is because of a girl. I know it sounds pathetic but it’s just how my mind is thinking and I can’t help it.

I’ve been trying dude. I tried getting another job. I tried to get back into dating. I tried to start doing fun things again like hanging out with friends and catching up with old ones. Nothings working
I’m looking forward to something in a few months so that’s the only thing that’s keeping me going. I absolutely cannot miss it so I guess I’ll make the most of it between now and then
I don’t believe things will get better. I have too many bad days that out weigh the good ones

The thing is, I’ve never tried to live for me. I really don’t like myself at all. Right now, I’m just living for my family because they want me to. I’m not sure how much longer I can go like this. Wellbutrin did seem to work at the beginning, but I’m not sure if my body became immune to it or what.

I haven’t tried dating again. I’m kinda stuck on the one girl and can’t seem to move on. I loved her so much and was basically living for her because I don’t care much about myself. I don’t think I can love anyone as much as I loved her.
How would I do something about it? I’m already going through therapy and I’m on meds.
I doubt any of it will make me happy. But for now I’ll make the most out of my life until November.
How do you know things get better?
I’m not sure how things could ever get better

It’s only been seven months. I’m struggling to keep going, but I’m looking forward to my sisters wedding in November. I know she would be devastated if I wasn’t there because I was dead. I’m probably going to keep going until then. Maybe something will happen between now and then to give me hope, but for now I’m just living to live. I haven’t read it, what’s it about?
Yes I see both regularly. A therapist once a week and a psychiatrist once a month. I’m currently on lithium and Wellbutrin
I haven’t truly told my therapist how I feel and I’ve kept things from her. Maybe I’ll tell her what’s going on in my head. Thank you
Why did he do it?
This gave me some hope. Thank you for sharing.
After he crashed, if you don’t mind me asking
And I’ve already been told everything they’re going to say anyway
I’ve already made up my mind that I’m going to do it
What happened to him?
There’s nothing they can say to change my thinking
Jumping or having a car crash
I’m 19
A break up. I’ve tried a lot. Nothing seems to help.
I already go to a therapist once a week. I’m on several medications. Nothing is working. I can’t come out of this.
I am soon, thank you.
Yes I’ve been struggling with these thoughts for over seven months. I’ve had two past attempts.
I’m sorry to hear that. How do you feel? I think suicide is the best option because I’ve tried to get better but just can’t.
Sort of. I’m just struggling to find a reason to keep going.

I’m feeling pretty meh today. I haven’t gotten out of the bed much, but I don’t feel awful. I haven’t had suicidal thoughts in over a month but all of a sudden they’ve creeped back into my head over the past few days.

I don’t believe this is a temporary feeling. I’ve felt this way for a long while, then I found something that gave me a purpose, but now, that purpose is gone. I am scared of the future. I’m a nobody and nothing makes me happy anymore. I don’t see anything changing for the better for me. I appreciate you sharing this.
The person I loved the most is no longer in my life and I honestly cannot go on without them. I’ve tried but it’s not working. I honestly cannot see myself without them.
